import duckdb

wide=sql.pivot_table(index="cohort",columns="age",values="guests",aggfunc="sum")

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
o=pd.read_csv("preorders.csv",parse_dates=["date"])
dau=o.groupby("date").guest_id.nunique().reindex(pd.date_range("2026-01-01","2026-06-30"),fill_value=0)
monthly=pd.DataFrame({"dau":dau.groupby(dau.index.to_period("M")).mean().round(1),"mau":o.groupby(o.date.dt.to_period("M")).guest_id.nunique()})
monthly["sticky"]=(monthly.dau/monthly.mau*100).round(1)
best_month=monthly.sticky.idxmax()
